description.en: Official Seal plugin index for DeepSeek Harness — evidence-backed Word/Office assembly and deterministic verification.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方 Seal 插件索引——证据驱动 Word/Office 文档装配与确定性核验工作台。

description.en: Evidence-backed Word/Office assembly and deterministic verification workbench (with bidding as the first end-to-end workflow): use the Seal sidebar page for knowledge vaults and starting bids, and the right session pane for review, page preview, and final export. Includes built-in MIT PDFium WASM (no Poppler needed); install free official LibreOffice to enable .doc/.xls import, page preview, and automatic TOC page numbers. Disabling the plugin removes Seal tools, panels, and skills while keeping local projects and vaults intact.
description.zh: 面向受控 Word/Office 交付的证据驱动文档装配与核验工作台（以招投标为首个端到端场景）：左侧「Seal」全局指挥台提供企业知识库建档与开启项目入口，会话右栏提供审阅清单、页面预览与定稿导出。已内置 MIT 协议 PDFium WASM 引擎，无需配置 Poppler；安装免费官方 LibreOffice 后可解锁 .doc/.xls 导入、页面预览与目录自动回填页码。停用插件后将移除 Seal 工具、审阅工作台与技能，项目及知识库文件仍保留在本地。
